warhead.provenance: 100 lb HE = 45.4 kg per OOB (csg-us-mk54-navy, A). Explosive/case split, lethal radius, and damage are engineering-estimate surrogates for a lightweight ASW torpedo against a submarine hull.

fuze.provenance: No public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate contact/magnetic-influence fuze typical of a lightweight ASW torpedo.

_real_world.role: ASW lightweight torpedo, launched from Mk 32 SVTT, MH-60R, P-8A, or as the VL-ASROC payload
_real_world.guidance_real: Active/passive acoustic homing (lightweight torpedo homing suite)
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for torpedoes; placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory (DDG Mk 32 triple tubes, MH-60R helo loadout, VLA payload)

warhead.type.note: blast: no public detonation-mechanism detail beyond HE fill mass; generic blast is the nearest real engine-recognized warhead type for an underwater HE lightweight-torpedo warhead

warhead.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

fuze.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

max_flight_time_s.note: no public endurance figure; engineering estimate derived from the ~6 nmi Mk46-lineage bound at the 20.6 m/s used speed

flight_model.max_speed.note: not public; Mk 46-lineage bound ~40 kt (est per OOB R17) = 20.6 m/s, no admissible source in this pass

flight_model.max_g.note: no public maneuver-load figure; engineering estimate for a lightweight torpedo's hydrodynamic turn limits

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate for a lightweight torpedo's rudder-limited turn rate, higher than the heavier Mk48

guidance.type.note: active/passive acoustic homing per OOB; the engine's guidance.type loader only recognizes ActiveRadar/Radar or IR/Infrared as a seeker_type, so acoustic homing has no matching engine category. This record has no functional mount anyway (mechanism gap, torpedo), so the field is descriptive metadata only

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public active-sonar acquisition range for Mk54; engineering estimate typical of a lightweight-torpedo active acoustic seeker, shorter than the heavier Mk48

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; record has no functional mount regardless

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode is modeled for this record's mechanism-gap weapon

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold; no public guidance-law constant, set low consistent with a torpedo's slower closing-speed homing loop

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, not sourced per-weapon

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold; set slower than an airframe missile, consistent with a torpedo's hydrodynamic control response

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold; set low consistent with a lightweight torpedo's control-surface response

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate for a lightweight ASW torpedo warhead against a submarine hull, no sourced lethal-radius figure

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public damage-effectiveness figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of the sourced 45.4 kg total warhead mass, no public split figure

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: 0.0 consistent with a contact-fuze trigger radius; no public influence-fuze standoff distance

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold typical of a contact/magnetic-influence exploder

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold value
